annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards the technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, vehicles produced in small series, fully automated vehicles produced in small series and special purpose vehicles, and as regards software update
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards the technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, vehicles produced in small series, fully automated vehicles produced in small series and special purpose vehicles, and as regards software update
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 296/1
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation amending the vehicle type-approval framework (Reg. 2018/858). It sets type-approval requirements for small-series, special purpose and fully automated vehicles, mandates software update management under UN Regulation 156, and sets annual unit limits for small-series fully automated vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduces whole-vehicle type-approval requirements for fully automated vehicles produced in small series (Table 2).
Requires software update management system compliant with UN Regulation No 156; refusal/prohibition dates from 2022 to 2029.
New small-series and special purpose vehicle requirements apply from 7 July 2024 (new types) and 7 July 2026 (all new vehicles).
Annual limit of 1,500 units for fully automated small-series vehicles of M2/M3/N2/N3 from 6 December 2022.
Cybersecurity and ADS-related items (driver availability, event data recorder) mapped to Regulation 2019/2144.
